name: dbml-translator
description: DBML schemas explained to non-developers, and gap analysis between DBML designs and product specs.

interface.shortDescription: Translate DBML schemas and diff them against product specs
interface.longDescription: Two skills for DBML workflows: dbml-explain turns a DBML schema into PM-readable narrative (entities, relations, enums, scenarios) and dbml-spec-diff compares a DBML schema against a PRD/기획서 to surface missing entities, drift, and cardinality conflicts.
defaultPrompt: Explain this DBML schema to a non-technical stakeholder
Compare this DBML schema against the product spec and find gaps
